prompts: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production pixel-art sprite sheet for Emberfell. Reference image shows the existing wooden boat and Corin's exact in-game sprites in plain brown clothes, with a sword, and with blue steel armor. Create Corin SITTING, knees bent and boots tucked forward, hands resting naturally on his lap, seated as a passenger on an invisible bench. Match the reference character's dark plum hair, large head, skin, brown clothing, blue armor and tiny pixel-art style as closely as possible. Make SIX isolated sprites on a genuinely transparent background, in a perfectly even 2-column by 3-row grid, no labels, no boat, no chair or bench, no shadows, no scenery. Column 1 faces straight south toward camera, column 2 faces straight north away from camera. Row 1 plain brown-clothes Corin without a weapon. Row 2 the same brown-clothes Corin with his short sword resting safely across his bent knees. Row 3 blue-armored Corin with sword resting across his knees. Clearly seated in every cell: torso upright, thighs horizontal/foreshortened and bent knees, no standing or walking pose. Whole character visible with consistent scale and alignment. Each cell should look like a crisp 32 by 32 logical-pixel game sprite enlarged 16 times: character approximately 18 logical pixels wide and 21 pixels tall, centered horizontally, head beginning at logical y=5 and boots ending at y=26. Canvas 1024 by 1536, each cell 512 by 512. Pixel-perfect hard edges, solid square color blocks, very limited palette, absolutely no antialiasing, gradients, outlines around cell edges, text, guides or watermark. Preserve exact hair silhouette and face from the reference; change only the seated pose and adapt clothing folds to it.

Edit this six-cell transparent pixel sprite sheet. KEEP the 2-column by 3-row arrangement, the three outfits (plain brown clothing, brown clothing with sword, blue armor with sword), and the SOUTH-FACING sprites in the LEFT column. FIX ONLY THE THREE NORTH-FACING sprites in the RIGHT column: these are seen FROM BEHIND while seated on a boat bench, looking AWAY from the viewer. The current image incorrectly puts the fronts of bent knees, shins and boot toes toward the viewer on the back view. REMOVE those forward-facing knees and front-facing boots from ALL right-column sprites. Show the back of his hair, back of his shirt/armor, elbows at his sides, and the back of his seated hips. His thighs and knees extend AWAY toward the top of the image, entirely occluded by his body; do not show legs projecting downward toward the viewer. At most tiny boot HEELS below the hips, never front-facing toes, no visible kneecaps. Sword should lie across his lap in FRONT of his body and therefore be mostly hidden by his torso in the back view, only small ends at the sides. He must unmistakably read as sitting facing north from behind, not a south-facing body with its head turned. No chair, no bench, no boat. Preserve the exact matching character proportions and dark plum hair, blue eyes and outfit palette of the original sheet. All SIX sprites on a genuinely transparent background with NO GLOW, NO shadow, NO haze, NO semitransparent edge pixels. Hard-edged pixel art, opaque solid color blocks and fully transparent empty areas only. Canvas 1024x1536, each of the six cells 512x512, consistent alignment. No text or grid lines.

Precise sprite correction. Change ONLY the bottom-right sprite of this 2-column, 3-row transparent sprite sheet. That bottom-right sprite is the armored boy SITTING FACING AWAY FROM CAMERA. DELETE the two bright blue square knee plates below his waist: those are front-facing knees and cannot be visible from behind. Replace that whole area below the belt with one simple continuous dark-plum trouser SEAT/hips silhouette, like the correctly seated rear-view brown-clothes sprites in the top-right and middle-right cells. Show only two tiny dark boot heels tucked below the hips. No kneecaps, no shins, no thighs facing camera, NO BLUE ARMOR PLATES BELOW THE BELT on this rear view. Keep his existing back armor, shoulder plates, belt and hair unchanged. ALL other five sprites and their alignment stay unchanged. Keep the exact image dimensions 1024x1536 and same cell placements. True transparent background, no extra objects, no text, no glow.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the provided six-cell Corin seated sprite sheet. Change ONLY the THREE NORTH-FACING REAR VIEW sprites in the RIGHT column. Remove EVERY visible skin-colored hand, finger, fist, wrist or forearm sticking out at his sides. His elbows can stay visible, fully covered by brown sleeves or armor, but bend his forearms FORWARD onto his lap, completely OCCLUDED behind the torso from this rear view. The rear view should show the back of the head, back of the shirt/armor, covered elbows, seated hips and tiny boot heels. There must be absolutely NO peach/skin-colored pixels or exposed flesh visible anywhere on these three rear views. No front-facing knees or legs. Keep the rear-view swords mostly hidden in front of the torso, only the small sword ends at the sides. Preserve EXACTLY the left column south-facing sprites, their hands, all six head silhouettes and dark-plum hair colors, outfits, sizes, position, alignment, overall 2-column by 3-row grid and original 1024x1536 dimensions. Keep crisp pixel art. True transparent background, no background, glow, shadow, text or additional objects. This is a tiny correction to the rear-facing hands only; do not redesign the sprites.
